description:
About the Position

Utrecht University invites applications for a postdoc in developmental psychology. The position supports the department's research on how children and adolescents develop, with topics spanning social, cognitive and emotional development and the conditions that support healthy development across contexts.

The postdoc will contribute to ongoing longitudinal and experimental studies, analyse developmental datasets and co-supervise doctoral and master's researchers. The role includes opportunities to develop an independent research line within the group's programme, and the appointment is a salaried postdoctoral contract under the CAO-NU collective agreement.

Candidate Profile

Applicants hold a PhD in developmental psychology, psychology or a related behavioural-science field, with strong quantitative skills and experience with developmental or longitudinal data. Experience with open-science practices and large-scale data collection is an advantage. The working language is English, and the department offers an active research-school environment.

Highlights

  • Social, cognitive and emotional development
  • Longitudinal and experimental study design
  • Developmental data analysis
  • Co-supervision of junior researchers
  • Independent research line development
  • Salaried postdoc under the CAO-NU agreement

About Utrecht University

Utrecht University is a leading Dutch research university, consistently ranked among the top institutions in Europe. Its research and teaching span four faculties and a broad range of strategic themes, including sustainability, dynamics of youth, institutions for open societies and life sciences. PhD candidates and postdocs in the Netherlands are salaried staff members with full employment benefits under the CAO-NU collective agreement, so advertised positions are fully funded. Academic and support vacancies are published on the university's working-at portal, with clear deadlines and application instructions per position.
